title: Lists
objectives: know how to create a list and read one item out of it by its index
understand how to traverse a list in order to total, count or compare its items
know how to add an item onto a list and how to take one out again

keyq: Why is the last item of a list always at index len(list) - 1?
exam: A loop over a list of six numbers begins for i in range(1, 6). State which item is never looked at, and rewrite the line so that every item is included.
Write a program that reads seven whole numbers into a list, then prints the largest and the position it is stored at, without using max().
Write a program that reads five words into a list, removes a word the user types in, then prints the words that are left and how many there are.
